description: Voruntersuchung, Eignungs-, Eigen-/Fremdueberwachung und Kontrollpruefungen je Werkstoff durchgefuehrt.
Formal acceptance with date and signed parties.

condition: ibn_datum IS NOT NULL AND ibn_befuellung_methode IS NOT EMPTY
description: First-fill plan addresses Fuellwasser pH/Haerte/Inhaltsstoffe and mechanical protection during filling.

condition: gewaesser_tiefe_m IS NOT NULL AND gewaesser_volumen_m3 IS NOT NULL AND nutzung_funktion IS NOT EMPTY AND hoechstwasserstand_m IS NOT NULL
description: Water-body function is defined to drive subsequent design choices.

condition: IF abdichtungs_art IN {bahn_bitumen,bahn_kunststoff_elastomer,fluessigkunststoff,bahn_pe} THEN wassereinwirkungsklasse IS NOT NULL AND rissklasse IS NOT NULL AND standortklasse IS NOT NULL
description: Wassereinwirkungsklasse, Rissklasse and Standortklasse assigned per Tab.18 for sheet-membrane sealings.

condition: if eisbildung_moeglich == true: documented ice-pressure protection
description: If ice formation cannot be excluded, edge / connection regions are protected from ice pressure.

condition: setzungen_zu_erwarten IS NOT NULL AND baugrund_typ IS NOT EMPTY AND baugrund_tragfaehig IS NOT NULL
description: Subsoil type identified, bearing capacity assessed, settlements addressed.
Confirm water-body type is in scope (not a landfill, fishery, dam, or waterway).
All requirements aggregated; verdict assigned; engineer + customer sign-off.

condition: Slope per Tab.1 row for chosen abdichtungs_art
description: Slope ratio complies with material-specific limit per Tab.1.

condition: Engineer-judged selection traceable to Sec.4.7 criteria
description: Sealing system matches usage, loads, root/rhizome regime, geometry.

condition: IF abdichtungs_art == mineralisch_ohne_zusatzstoffe THEN kornanteil_unter_2micron >= 15 AND organische_substanz_VGL <= 5 AND kalkgehalt_VCA <= 15 AND kf_abdichtung <= 0.000000001 AND verdichtungsgrad_Dpr >= 97
description: kf <= 1e-9 m/s, Kornanteil <2um >= 15%, organische Substanz <= 5%, Kalk <= 15%, Verdichtungsgrad >= 97% per Tab.3.

condition: IF abdichtungs_art == mineralisch_mit_zusatzstoffen THEN mz_durchlaessigkeit_kf <= 0.000000001 AND mz_dichtungswirkung_nachgewiesen == true
description: Schichtdicken per Tab.5 and Eignungspruefung per Sec.5.2.3.1.

condition: IF abdichtungs_art == mineralisch_hydraulisch THEN ((bauteildicke_cm <= 40 AND wasserzementwert <= 0.60 AND zementgehalt_kg_m3 >= 280) OR (bauteildicke_cm > 40 AND wasserzementwert <= 0.70))
description: w/z, Zementgehalt, fck, Mindestdicke per Tab.6 and Tab.8 met (depending on Bauteildicke).
Nenndicken for Asphaltmastix/Gussasphalt/wasserdichter Asphaltbeton per Tab.12.

condition: IF abdichtungs_art == verbundwerkstoff_gtd THEN ((bentonit_type == "Na" AND bentonit_flaecheneinheit_g_m2 >= 3600 AND quellvermoegen_ml >= 24) OR (bentonit_type == "Ca" AND bentonit_flaecheneinheit_g_m2 >= 8000 AND quellvermoegen_ml >= 8)) AND gtd_ueberlappung_laengs_cm >= 30 AND gtd_ueberlappung_quer_cm >= 50
description: Bentonit, Geotextil and complete GTD product per Tab.13, Tab.14, Tab.15.
Bahnenart per Tab.19, mehrlagig per Sec.6.1.1.2, root-/rhizome-test per Sec.6.1.1.
Bahnendicke >= 1.2 mm (>= 1.0 mm prefab Gartenteich); Mindestfuegebreite per Tab.22.
Klassen-Kurzzeichen-System (M/S, W1-W3, P1-P4, S1-S4, TL1-TL4, TH1-TH4) angegeben.

title_de: PE-Bahnen - PEHD per Tab.24/25, PELD mit FLL-Wurzeltest
condition: IF abdichtungs_art == bahn_pe THEN peeh_dichte_g_cm3 > 0.940 AND peeh_mfr >= 1.0 AND peeh_mfr <= 3.0 AND peeh_russgehalt_pct >= 2 AND peeh_russgehalt_pct <= 3
description: PEHD per Tab.24 (Dichte, MFR, Russ, OIT, NCTL); PELD requires FLL root-test.
Edelstahl-Auswahl je nach Korrosionsbelastung; Verzinkungsdicke >= 100 um falls unlegiert.

condition: IF abdichtungs_art == alkalisilikat THEN schichtdicke_abdichtung_cm >= 25 AND feinkornanteil_063_pct >= 20
description: Schichtdicke >= 25 cm; Feinkornanteil < 0,063 mm >= 20%; Pflanzenkompatibilitaet beachten.
Required LBO building permits identified and applied for.
Decision on whether a WHG discharge permit is required.

condition: If required and abdichtung not inherently resistant: separate Wurzelschutzbahn
description: If aggressive plants are present, root-/rhizome-resistant sealing or Wurzelschutzbahn is provided.
Free terrain: >= 5 cm; Building/Bauteil: >= 30 cm (or >= 15 cm with adapted fastening).
Above and below protection per Sec.8 and Tab.26-27 based on Baugrund und Belastung.
Plants screened against Tab.29 list; Wurzel-/Rhizompruefung as required.
Product compliance verified for the chosen sealing.
Yearly inspection plan; maintenance concept (intervals, scope); repair triggers.
